In the week that followed Squoat's assignment to Emmett, Emmett became almost lethargic. All he could think about was grass, yet he tried to play things off as if he did not need the drug. There were frequent times when he was noticeably shaking and times when he looked sick, but a lot of the crew found him to be in an adequate state for going through withdrawals. That was until Garrick found Emmett hiding in the engine room, munching on a batch of the green stuff. The ghostly figure, strangely acting like an angel, tackled the Squoatling over and stole the grass from him. From there on, the Vortox Pummelers were always keeping a watch on him. Aside from Seth, who ignored everything and indulged in more vice, the crew decided to care for Emmett's predicament, keeping in mind that he was the only Squoatling the galaxy knew of and that it would be awful for him to be further hurt by his addiction. Sanya and Garrick set up shifts where they would watch Emmett. This was where Emmett became idle, refusing to eat, play video games, pilot, or do anything really. He felt like his privacy was invaded, and he could not stand it.

One night in particular, the Squoatling was able to breathe. The others were exhausted, and Garrick was on the gaseous planet below completing a personal mission. This was his chance. He got up weakly, given his silent protest and fasting. Wobbly, he trekked the long distance of ten feet to the refrigerator and feasted upon some of Iris's brownies and a club sandwich he made from veraberry leaves, a poultry-like meat, and shed skin flakes from a goon, a particularly tasty farm animal. It was heavenly to him, and his stomach was quickly filled. Happy, Emmett reached in a cabinet for his little snack, but alas, Sanya and Garrick took extra measures to keep him away from it. The grass had a little device that would set ablaze both the person who picked it up and itself. This would cause the fire alarm to go off, waking everyone up, and notifying Garrick down below. He could not let this night of freedom go to waste. The goat took himself over to the pilot's chair and waited for a few minutes before realizing that he did not know what to do. He could do anything really, and no one could judge him. What to do was still the question, however. Emmett's hooves seemed to have a mind of their own while he contemplated his potential decision, scratching various parts of his body out of a need for grass. Once Emmett was touching his inner thigh, he chuckled to himself, finally devising a plan of action.

MaskedMasquerade™ turned out to be really difficult to find an on-the-spot hookup. The dating site that prided itself on anonymous one-time flairs was really letting him down. He was propped on a bean bag chair in the den, slightly slouched while one of his hooves was deep within a bag of crisps. Yawning, the Kid began to murmur to himself.

"[I have everything. A brief personality, a picture of my hot bod, my romantic interests, and even a short section about how urgent this should be. Why is no one online?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He was idly staring at his holoscreen, waiting for a response. He should have planned this earlier in advance, but he could not be seen making a dating profile while the rest of the crew was monitoring him, let alone be caught taking pictures of himself nude. Just as Emmett was about to hang his towel for the day, his device blared a little violin tune. Startled, he immediately muted his device. "[What the hell?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett gasped, his heart rushing from the loudness in the midst of the night. The sound came from someone responding to his profile with the message, "[You look hot. We'll skip dinner and get right to the dirty. Thirty minutes tops. Please respond quickly.]{Llamanian Woman}" Emmett smiled to himself and responded with a "[Where?]{Emmett Tawfeek}", happy to know that someone was there to relieve him of his lonesomeness. It took a few minutes for the being to respond, and when it did, it distributed coordinates to "[My place]{Llamanian Woman}". Just as Emmett was about to get the ship started, the being replied once more, stating, "[Bring nothing but your holo device. I want to see if you're being truthful about your girth]{Llamanian Woman}". Emmett shrugged to himself, not at all suspicious, and started to strip while the ship moved onward to the coordinates; the ship was in incognito mode, so at least no one could wake up from engine or inertia.

Right as the ship stopped at a motel, Emmett was putting on an Elven cycle helmet, a headgear that was gifted to him by Seth a while back. The helmet was of perfect size to him, and it looked extremely similar to a motorcycle helmet, aside from the obvious pointy ears on its sides. Before disembarking, he checked out the place through the window next to the entrance. He had an uneasy feeling, given the reputation of most space motels.

"[Emmett, remind me, why are you naked again?]{Dakari}" Dakari was sitting behind him, almost laughing at Emmett's embarrassment.

"[Thought everyone was asleep, including you]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett muttered, covering his shame. He did not turn around yet, but he was clearly embarrassed.

"[I heard a strange tune in the den, so I came out to investigate. Were you watching porn or something?]{Dakari}" Dakari put his watch to his mouth, ready to tell the others Emmett was leaving the ship. Emmett quickly pulled the stun gun that was duct-taped to the wall and he pointed it at Dakari.

"[Sorry, man, but I need this. You need more sleep, anyhow. It was a long mission yesterday.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Right as Dakari started to squeal, Emmett pulled the trigger, temporarily paralyzing the ninja porcupine. Quickly, Emmett dropped the stun gun and opened the ship hatch, hoping no one would be on his trail.

The atmosphere outside of the motel was dark and freezing to Emmett. Even at a cool thirteen degrees Celsius, Emmett desperately wanted to get into the motel room. He was hoping this mystery woman would warm him up in the depths of addiction and lonesomeness, even if it were only for a one-night stand. Right as he began to knock on her door, the door swung open, and a tall, furry woman picked him up and crashed him onto a bed. Emmett was once again startled by the quickness of everything, and he could not tell his assailant's intentions due to the papier-mâché Viking mask she had on.

"[What's going on?!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Very quickly Emmett started to warm up to the place, both literally and figuratively. While their meeting was short and aggressive, the mystery woman got off of him and admired his natural stature.

"[I read that you liked surprises, so I put you in your place.]{Llamanian Woman}" She giggled in a way that felt a little intimidating to Emmett, and to not be awkward, Emmett nervously laughed along. Mentally he facepalmed. *Why would I ever put that I liked surprises down?* The woman closed the door and locked it, curling some of her hair that was protruding from her makeshift helmet. "[Is this your first time on MaskedMasquerade™?]{Llamanian Woman}" She flicked one of her spaghetti-strings off of her shoulder, revealing a bit of her breast. Naturally Emmett noticed this and became more aroused, having calmed down from before.

"[Yes, it's my first time. I just needed someone to warm me up, you know?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" As he said this, the woman took out some handcuffs.

"[I understand. Now, if we're going to do this, I need to trust you won't leave me. I'm going to handcuff you to my bed while I get ready. Is that fine?]{Llamanian Woman}" One of Emmett's arms began to shake a little, so he grabbed it to try and stop it.

"[That's fine. Pretty kinky.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[You have no idea.]{Llamanian Woman}" She cuffed his wrists to the stands of the bed's headrest, having two pairs of handcuffs. She then looked at his back hooves, picked one up to her mask, and gently knocked on it. Emmett found this strangely sensual—no one ever really cared about how well he maintained his hooves. "[Now stay there.]{Llamanian Woman}" She chuckled at her ironic statement. Emmett rolled his eyes a bit as she closed the bathroom door. He did not have much to do but wait. For about ten minutes, he admired her decor, seeing that she had a rather interesting taste in scenery. She liked the punk rock band Imp Arising, she was interested in pirates, and she had a signed insignia of the Llamanian sigil. Wait a moment.

"[I'm ready!]{Llamanian Woman}" Right when the door opened up, the room was filled with a mesmerizing aroma, and she was glowing. Emmett immediately forgot about the insignia as his eyes wandered up and down her luscious body.

"[Woah]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett muttered in awe.

"[That's right. I'm hot.]{Llamanian Woman}" She got onto the bed and crawled up atop Emmett's chest. Before he could try to do anything, she pulled off his cycle helmet and began to choke him. "[I knew it! Gotcha, Squoatling.]{Llamanian Woman}"

Everything began to make sense now. She was being extremely cryptic with her messages, she told him to come without anything to defend himself, and she locked him to the bed so she could get her way. Of course, when in tandem with the Llamanian insignia, that only meant one thing… She was a Llamanian! Emmett tried desperately to slip out of the handcuffs as she closed her pads around his neck.

"[I'll certainly be admitted back into the military after they've seen that I caught you!]{Llamanian Woman}" Emmett was trying to breathe to no avail, and he began to audibly choke. He tried pointing to his neck as if he were trying to tell her that he needed air. Of course, why would she care? She just needed to knock him out. However, after a few more seconds of hearing his croaks, she chickened out and let go. Emmett hyperventilated as a result.

"[This… this feels wrong.]{Llamanian Woman}" She uncuffed one of his wrists and got off of him. Instead of trying to get his other wrist free, he left his hoof on his chest, feeling his heartbeat pulse frantically. The Llamanian took off her helmet, showing her face, slightly disfigured by war scars. "[I don't know why I'm letting you go, but I can't put up with being a two-faced trickster.]{Llamanian Woman}" She had a long pause as Emmett's breathing slowly went back to normal. "[Have you ever had the feeling that you let your life be thrown away due to someone else's decisions?]{Llamanian Woman}" She looked back at him, unsure of how he would respond. Aware of the irony of her question, Emmett nodded. "[I was kicked out of the Llamanian armada because of my mercy. I've caught hundreds of Squoatlings in my time as a general. I've only killed one, and that was in self-defense. My life has spiraled since then, and all I have known is the armada life.]{Llamanian Woman}" Emmett had no idea how to respond. "[You guys just wanted to live your lives, and we came in and destroyed everything you knew and loved because of that.]{Llamanian Woman}" The Squoatling felt a little uncomfortable, but he tried to keep his thoughts on her body to keep himself occupied while she monologued. "[I'm not fit for the military. They want to slaughter you guys as they're warmongers. They believe that Lla wishes for them to conquer everyone. That we're the one true race. Squoatling, how old are you?]{Llamanian Woman}" This question came really quickly to him, as she could tell that he was staring at her breasts before he answered her.

"[Me? Oh, I'm like twenty-two GUYs. My Squoat-given day is pretty soon.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[You lived probably half of your life in space because of us. It's ridiculous.]{Llamanian Woman}" Emmett spoke up, having enough of the downer talk.

"[What's ridiculous is how I'm still erect after all of this.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The Llamanian peered over his rod and blushed softly.

"[Well, it's the least I can do for you as a Llamanian.]{Llamanian Woman}"

After their escapade, Emmett cuddled with the Llamanian for a bit and put his helmet back on, claiming that he would see her again one day. He left the motel, and by the time he reached the ship, Sanya and Garrick were at the hatch, clearly upset.

"[Sorry about this, guys. I just needed some space from you.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Sanya uncharacteristically hugged Emmett.

"[I was worried about you. I don't want to see you getting into trouble.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Emmett was confused by her action, but he hugged back anyhow. Garrick, on the other hand, was not easily swayed.

"[You left me on the smelly planet. Sanya had to fly the crew back over to me and nearly wrecked the ship.]{Garrick}" The ghost slapped the Squoatling, but he did not retaliate. He was in a really good mood from his encounter with the Llamanian. Sanya pulled away from him afterwards.

"[Get some clothes on. Your thing bothers me.]{Sanya Dreadflower}"
